description: This file defines the ActiveLinkResponseFilter class, which subscribes to HTTP response events to modify HTML responses by adding 'is-active' classes and aria-current attributes to active links, primarily for anonymous users. It implements event subscription, response handling, and HTML link modification logic.

classes.name: ActiveLinkResponseFilter
classes.description: A class that subscribes to response events to modify HTML responses by adding active link classes and attributes for anonymous users.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with current user, path, path matcher, and language manager services.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Handles the response event, modifies HTML content to add active link classes if conditions are met.

methods.name: setLinkActiveClass
methods.description: Static method that parses HTML markup to add 'is-active' class and aria-current attribute to links matching the current path, language, and query parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the response event with a priority to run after other subscribers.
